scene_timeline.visual_description: Riz Ahmed, Guz Khan, and Hasan Minhaj appear in a three-way split-screen video call. Riz discusses fan art featuring their friend group.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Riz Ahmed mentions fan art of himself, Ramy Youssef, Mo Amer, and Hasan Minhaj, questioning the existence of a secret WhatsApp group.
scene_timeline.text_on_screen: cuz someone drew some fan art of you and Ramy; you two and Ramy and Mo Amer; I'm guessing you were joking but you said yeah; I've sent this to the WhatsApp group; and I was like "Hahaha as if there's a WhatsApp group" innit; coz then...

scene_timeline.audio_description: Guz Khan jokingly denies being the administrator of the alleged secret group chat.
scene_timeline.text_on_screen: I just want to say I'm not admin; I'm not admin; Hilarious

scene_timeline.visual_description: Riz Ahmed continues the joke while Hasan and Guz react with mock outrage and laughter.

parsed_output.overall_summary: In this humorous video call snippet, actors Riz Ahmed, Guz Khan, and Hasan Minhaj engage in playful banter regarding 'side threads' and exclusive WhatsApp groups. Riz starts by teasing the others about a group chat he was excluded from, which Guz jokingly denies managing. Riz then turns the tables by revealing he has a private, two-person chat with Mahershala Ali, leaving Hasan and Guz jokingly begging for an invite. The video highlights the lighthearted friendship and shared cultural humor between the three stars.
